instruction:
Open /home/user/Desktop/slot_plate.step in FreeCAD 0.21.2 Path/CAM. To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH). For this task, use `/usr/lib/freecad/bin/freecadcmd-python3` for FreeCAD Path command-line automation when working on `slot_plate.step`.

The STEP is the finished 120 x 80 x 18 mm plate model and contains one centered X-axis obround through-slot: 40 mm overall length, 8 mm width, end radius 4 mm, straight centerline endpoints (-16, 0) and (16, 0) mm, top Z=18 mm, and bottom Z=0 mm. Create one Path/CAM Job with zero stock extension so its bounding-box stock is the complete 120 x 80 x 18 mm starting block. Use exactly two active operations in this order: (1) a Slot operation to rough the stated centerline and (2) a Pocket Shape operation based on the slot wall geometry to clear the full obround region. Use multiple depth layers in both operations and reach final source-coordinate Z=0.000 mm without cutting below it. Use T1, a 6 mm flat end mill, with clockwise spindle S8500 rpm and horizontal cutting feed F500 mm/min. Export the Job through FreeCAD's LinuxCNC postprocessor. Save the native Job and posted program at exactly /home/user/Desktop/task-02.FCStd and /home/user/Desktop/task-02.nc.
